p = model.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="peanut_butter_crepes", lb=0)

model.addConstr(4 * p <= 450, name="peanut_butter_spread")

# Popularity constraint: peanut butter crepes must exceed chocolate crepes
model.addConstr(p >= c, name="pb_at_least_chocolate")
